title: Restricted first-row Cauchy-sum identity for q-Whittaker and skew Schur polynomials with 0 < q < 1
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) article 064, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2024.064; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author equates two different Fredholm determinants by adding infinitely many geometric pole families while preserving each finite-stage determinant. The proof needs residue row reductions, conjugated Hilbert–Schmidt factorization, uniform Fredholm-series bounds and contour estimates near an essential singularity at infinity. The polynomial identity is then obtained from the probabilistic parameter region by the author-stated continuation argument.
author: Takashi Imamura; Matteo Mucciconi; Tomohiro Sasamoto
